Problem Statement:
Given a number N, print all prime numbers less than N(in ascending order). 
Input Description:
Input Size : 1 <= N <= 100000 
Output Description:
The output consists of all prime numbers less than N, printed in ascending order, separated by spaces. 
Sample Input:
10 
Sample Output:
2 3 5 7
